title: 1. Combatant results
description: These rows show remaining health and combat totals for you and other combatants. Select either row to inspect that combatant's ability breakdown.

title: 2. Ability breakdown
description: This table shows how often each ability was used or triggered and how much damage, healing, or barrier it produced.

title: 3. Your first Essence
description: Victory awarded an unbound Goblin's Essence. Open Essences, then absorb it into your Soul Archive to continue the tutorial.
